description: Presentation contract for the BrandInput controls (labels/groups/UI ranges/knob types). Rendered by the Figma plugin, the web playground, and the MCP tool schema. Kept in sync with theme-schema.json by engine/test.ts. Emitted by engine/emit-levers.ts. Note: brand `id` is host-supplied identity, not a lever.

levers.label: Primary brand color
levers.description: The exact brand anchor. Pinned, never shifted; the engine places it on the ramp by its lightness.

levers.label: Neutral hue
levers.description: Hue the grays lean toward (a small chroma tints them to the brand for cohesion).

levers.label: Neutral chroma
levers.description: Peak neutral chroma (~0.004–0.02); tapers to near-0 at the ramp ends. 0 = pure gray.

levers.label: Pin a neutral
levers.description: Optional. A pre-defined brand gray, pinned verbatim at its lightness step; the ramp is built around it (hue/chroma from the anchor) instead of the cast. Set for a client that ships their own neutral; omit to derive from hue + chroma.

levers.label: Additional brand colors
levers.description: Secondary / tertiary / accents — any number; each becomes its own ramp and can drive actions.

levers.label: Action palette
levers.description: Which palette drives interactive/action color. Defaults to primary; point at an accent when the hero color is a poor CTA.

levers.label: Link palette
levers.description: Which palette drives link color. Defaults to following the action color, including a roleColors.action override; point at primary, neutral, or an accent to give links their own color. The contrast floor holds either way. A link palette that is not color-distinct from body text (e.g. neutral) prompts a warning to underline links for WCAG 1.4.1 — pair it with an underlined link role.

levers.label: Success color
levers.description: Optional measured override; omit to let the engine synthesize from a canonical hue.

levers.label: Warning color
levers.description: Optional measured override; omit to synthesize.

levers.label: Danger color
levers.description: Optional measured override; omit to reuse the brand red (if red) or carve a dedicated one.

levers.label: Info color
levers.description: Optional measured override; omit to synthesize from the canonical blue hue.

levers.label: Page surfaces
levers.description: Non-default page and inverse surfaces per mode. The contrast floor follows the second tier.

levers.label: Strict interactive contrast
levers.description: Opt-in (off by default). The inverse filled button steps its fill per state; the primary and destructive labels’ colored ink clears AA at rest but dips on the transient hover/pressed steps. On swaps both inverse labels to the neutral high-contrast ink so every state clears AA — guaranteed legibility over brand color.

levers.label: Link states
levers.description: Optional. Set how far each engaged link state — hover, pressed, visited — steps from the resting link, one state at a time, as a count of ramp steps. An unset state keeps the tuned walk; the resting link and its focus follow the link palette. Each step is held to the link’s contrast floor, so it respaces a state without dropping the link below 4.5:1.

levers.label: Corner softness
levers.description: How rounded corners are: 0 is sharp, 1 is the default, 2 is soft. Every corner radius scales with it.

levers.label: Density
levers.description: Sets control heights, and moves each component’s padding and gaps one step on the spacing scale. Token names stay the same; their values change. Spacing follows the brand’s density, not the mode’s: a mode’s density changes control heights only.

levers.label: Control shape
levers.description: The corner shape of buttons and other controls that can round fully. Boxed is sharp (0px). Hairline is a 1px corner. Rounded follows corner softness. Pill rounds the ends fully, whatever the softness.

levers.label: Button icons
levers.description: Where button icons sit. Attached to label keeps them beside the label. Locked to edges pins them to the button edges and centers the label in the space between.

levers.label: Button label & icon
levers.description: The label and icon size of a medium button. One step smaller gives it the small button’s label and icon at the same height and padding. Small and large buttons are unchanged.

levers.label: Button label weight
levers.description: The weight of a button label: Emphasis (600 by default) or Default (400). Default adds that weight to the label styles. Tags and badges keep Emphasis.

levers.label: Button minimum width
levers.description: A button is at least its height times this wide, rounded up to the 8px grid, so a short label never makes a stubby button.

levers.label: Base radius
levers.description: The medium corner radius, in px, at corner softness 1. The other corner radii scale from it.

levers.label: Hairline radius
levers.description: Retired. radius.hairline, a fixed 1px corner, is always emitted, so this setting changes nothing.
levers.deprecated: Always on since #2053: radius.hairline is emitted for every brand. Accepted so existing brand files still load.

levers.label: Type scale
levers.description: How far apart the heading sizes step. Body, label, caption and code stay put.

levers.label: Font families
levers.description: The font family each text type uses, and whether it is a variable font. A single family name gets a system fallback stack added. Setting code to none ships no code styles.

levers.label: Weights
levers.description: The weight number behind each name. The names read in order, from subtle to max. The defaults are 300, 400, 600, 700 and 900.

levers.label: Largest display size
levers.description: The largest display size the brand makes. Display sizes above it are left out. It names a step, not a pixel value, so changing the type scale never changes how many display sizes are kept.

levers.label: Smallest title size
levers.description: 16px adds a title at body size. The Compact scale already places a title at 16px, so the engine refuses 16px with it.

levers.label: Smallest caption size
levers.description: 10px adds a fine-print caption, for dense legal, footer or product details. The default smallest caption is 11px.

levers.label: Smallest type size
levers.description: 8px adds the smallest caption and moves the smallest type size down to 8px. That is below the sizes the contrast checks were set for, so the engine notes it: use it only for fine print that has an accessible alternative.

levers.label: Headings scale between mobile and desktop
levers.description: Display, title and eyebrow sizes shrink smoothly from desktop to mobile between these two screen widths. Body text keeps one size.

levers.label: Weights each text type ships
levers.description: Which weights each text type ships. Each weight is a text style at every size. Every text type keeps at least one; label keeps Emphasis, and body and caption keep Default, because buttons and form controls use them.

levers.label: Underlined link styles
levers.description: Which text types get an underlined link style. The default is body and caption.

levers.label: Italic styles
levers.description: Which text types ship an italic style for each weight. The default is none.

levers.label: Italic-only text types
levers.description: Which text types are italic only: every style is italic, with no upright style. The default is none. A text type here can’t also be in Italic styles.

levers.label: Motion tempo
levers.description: How fast every duration runs: Snappy is 0.8×, Standard 1×, Relaxed 1.3×. Reduced motion is set for you.

levers.label: Shadow softness
levers.description: Blur:offset dial. Low → crisp/product; high → soft/marketing.

levers.label: Shadow tint
levers.description: How far the shadow color moves off pure black, and toward which hue. Amount 0 is pure black; the default is a slight neutral tint.

levers.label: Breakpoints
levers.description: The screen width where each layout starts, smallest first. The first is always 0px. Names follow the count: up to five run sm to 2xl, six or seven run xs to 3xl. The default is 0, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920.

levers.label: Grid columns
levers.description: How many columns the grid has on the widest breakpoints. Smaller breakpoints step up to it: 4, then 8, then this count.

levers.label: Maximum width
levers.description: The widest content gets. Below this width, content fills the screen.

levers.label: Content container
levers.description: A narrower width for long text, so lines stay a readable length.

levers.label: Icon contrast floor
levers.description: Whether icons mirror text contrast or run against the WCAG 1.4.11 non-text floor. Matching text is the default on purpose: icons usually sit beside text, and an icon that is lighter than the label next to it reads as a mistake even though 3:1 conforms. Choose the non-text floor when icons stand alone or you want them to recede.

levers.label: Disabled contrast
levers.description: Full guarantees AA text on disabled controls — legibility is certain, but the disabled look then rests on fill / border / cursor rather than dimming. Reduced dims it to a floor you set, never below 3:1.

levers.label: Reduced contrast floor
levers.description: How dim Reduced goes. 3:1 is the WCAG non-text / large-text threshold and where Primer and USWDS sit — the lowest ratio still legible. Escalates to 4.5:1 in high-contrast modes. Ignored on Full.

levers.label: Outline hover
levers.description: How outline/text controls express hover/pressed/selected. Overlay = translucent neutral wash (composites over any surface); solid-tint = the control's own fill at 20% opacity (30% pressed), stepped down the opacity scale where the label needs more contrast and up where the hover would not show, so a destructive outline hovers red-tinted rather than gray; none = omit.

levers.label: Neutral emphasis
levers.description: The neutral interactive fill boldness — subtle light gray (a surface) or a strong near-black/near-white fill.

levers.label: Interactive palettes
levers.description: Promote declared palettes (a `brandColors` entry, or `primary`) to full interactive.<name>.* columns — fill/states, on-fill, text, border, overlay. The generalized accent lever; edit via the interactive cards. Supersedes the back-compat single-column `accentPalette` input.

levers.label: Gradients
levers.description: Opt-in (off by default). On ships one default brand gradient; an explicit array ships specific ones.
